hero.title: THE COLLEGE JOURNEY
hero.subtitle: A University Story of Grit, Growth, Sacrifices, and Victory
hero.description: An intimate, cinematic chronicle of a college odyssey—from freshman campus orientation and late-night library study sessions to standing proud with a BSIT-MWA diploma. A tribute to Mom & Dad whose unconditional support built every milestone.
hero.degree: Bachelor of Science in Information Technology - Mobile and Web Applications (BSIT-MWA)

welcome.title: Welcome, Mom and Dad
welcome.subtitle: Before we begin this journey, I'd like to thank you from the bottom of my heart.
welcome.greeting: Tonight, we are looking back at the university years—the campus mornings, the late-night library marathons, the exam pressures, and the sacrifices you made to keep my BSIT-MWA dreams alive.
welcome.quote: “To the world, you may be two people. But to me, you are the entire world that made this degree possible.”

episodes.title: Episode 1: Freshman Year
episodes.subtitle: Campus Orientation, Dorm Life & New Horizons
episodes.summary: Stepping onto the university campus for the first time—setting up the dorm room, attending freshman orientation, and writing the first 'Hello World' in BSIT-MWA lab.
fullStory: Freshman year began with the excitement and nerves of stepping into a massive university campus. Unpacking bags in the dorm room, seeing the lecture halls, and holding my schedule felt like entering a brand new world.
Mom, you helped me organize my desk and packed homemade food so I wouldn't miss home. Dad, your firm handshake before driving away gave me the quiet confidence that I belonged here.
From the first BSIT-MWA 101 lecture to making campus friends over late-night coffee, freshman year laid the foundation for everything that was to come.

episodes.title: Episode 2: Sophomore Year
episodes.subtitle: Data Structures, Hackathons & Late-Night Study Groups
episodes.summary: Diving deep into BSIT-MWA—tackling Mobile & Web Architecture, joining university tech clubs, and competing in 24-hour hackathons with classmates.
fullStory: Sophomore year brought a significant leap in academic intensity. Late nights at the university library became second nature as web algorithms, mobile app dev, and database systems filled my timetable.
I formed a close group of college friends. We spent weekends at 24-hour campus hackathons, building web & mobile apps, debugging code together, and sharing late-night pizza.
Even when academic pressure peaked, calls from home were my anchor. Dad reminded me to stay disciplined, while Mom ensured I was eating properly and resting.

episodes.title: Episode 3: The Hardest Semester
episodes.subtitle: Junior Stress, Financial Sacrifice & Family Support
episodes.summary: The raw, emotional valley of the college journey. Managing tuition costs, brutal exam weeks, late-night breakdowns, and finding hope through family love.
fullStory: Junior year was the most demanding chapter of college. Complex mobile application frameworks, web security, and impending senior thesis prep created intense pressure.
Financial burdens weighed heavily on our family. I saw how hard Mom and Dad worked to cover my tuition fees, quietly sacrificing their own needs so I could stay enrolled without stress.
There were nights when code broke at 3 AM and exhaustion set in. But knowing how much Mom and Dad sacrificed gave me the strength to wipe away tears, pick up my laptop, and keep grinding.

episodes.title: Episode 4: Senior Year Mastery
episodes.subtitle: Capstone Project, Modern Web Stack & Tech Purpose
episodes.summary: Mastering modern web development—building React component architectures, state management, UI design systems, and completing the senior capstone thesis.
fullStory: Senior year was where all the BSIT-MWA years came together. From mobile frameworks to building production-ready web applications, code became my craft.
I spent senior semester engineering complex web platforms, refining UI/UX designs, and defense-testing software architectures.
Building this very Netflix-themed application was the ultimate milestone—crafted with every BSIT-MWA skill learned throughout college to honor Mom and Dad.

episodes.title: Episode 5: Commencement Day
episodes.subtitle: Cap & Gown, Diploma Honor & Shared Victory
episodes.summary: Walking across the university commencement stage in black cap and gown, receiving the BSIT-MWA diploma, and celebrating shared victory with Mom & Dad.
fullStory: Graduation morning arrived under a bright blue sky. Fitting into the graduation cap and gown felt surreal—the culmination of 4 years of college dedication.
As my name was called over auditorium loudspeakers and I stepped onto the main stage, I looked into the audience to see Mom holding back tears of joy and Dad standing proud.
Receiving the degree scroll and turning the tassel was our shared victory. This diploma belongs to Mom and Dad just as much as it belongs to me.

letters.title: To My Dearest Mom
letters.subtitle: A Letter of College Gratitude
letterContent: Throughout my 4 years of college, your love was my constant shelter. From packing care packages during exam weeks to calling me every single evening to check if I was eating well, your care never wavered.
When university felt overwhelming and coding assignments stretched late into the night, your words gave me the peace and courage to keep pushing forward.
Today, as I hold this BSIT-MWA diploma, I want you to know that half of this achievement belongs to you. Your quiet sacrifices made this day possible.
Thank you for being my mother, my comfort, and my greatest strength.
letters.signature: With all my love and devotion, Your Child

letters.title: To My Hero, My Dad
letters.subtitle: A Letter of Respect and Gratitude
letterContent: Your relentless work ethic and integrity inspired me every single day of my university journey. Watching how hard you worked to fund my college education taught me what true dedication means.
You taught me to face academic challenges with discipline, speak truthfully, and never give up when problems got tough.
Dad, when I walked across that commencement stage today, I held my head high because I am your child. Your sacrifices opened doors for me, and I promise to make you proud throughout my career.
Thank you for being my hero, my guide, and my pillar of strength.
letters.signature: With deepest respect and love, Your Child
